examples.en: The light switch is next to the door.
examples.zh: 電燈開關就在門旁邊。

examples.en: The switch to the new system took only one weekend.
examples.zh: 改用新系統只花了一個週末。

examples.en: A sudden switch in the weather ruined our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 天氣突然轉變，打亂了我們的野餐計畫。

examples.en: Can we switch seats so I can sit by the window?
examples.zh: 我們可以換位子嗎？我想坐在窗邊。

examples.en: She decided to switch to a healthier breakfast.
examples.zh: 她決定改吃更健康的早餐。

examples.en: Please switch off your phones before the movie starts.
examples.zh: 電影開演前，請把手機關掉。

examples.en: New technology has changed the way students study.
examples.zh: 新科技改變了學生讀書的方式。

examples.en: My uncle works for a company that makes medical technology.
examples.zh: 我叔叔任職於一家製造醫療技術設備的公司。

examples.en: Modern technology makes it easy to talk with friends abroad.
examples.zh: 現代科技讓我們很容易與國外的朋友聊天。

examples.en: Please read the text on page ten carefully.
examples.zh: 請仔細閱讀第十頁的課文。

examples.en: I got a text from my sister this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上收到姊姊傳來的簡訊。

examples.en: The text on the poster is too small to read.
examples.zh: 海報上的文字太小，看不清楚。

examples.en: I will text you when I arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 我到車站時會傳簡訊給你。

examples.en: Please do not text while you are driving.
examples.zh: 開車時請不要傳簡訊。

examples.en: She texted her mother to say she would be late.
examples.zh: 她傳簡訊告訴媽媽她會晚點到。

examples.en: Long walks in the sun tire me out quickly.
examples.zh: 在大太陽下走長路，我很快就累了。

examples.en: The little boy began to tire after the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，小男孩開始感到疲倦。

examples.en: I never tire of listening to her stories.
examples.zh: 我聽她說故事怎麼聽都不膩。

examples.en: My bicycle has a flat tire again.
examples.zh: 我的腳踏車輪胎又沒氣了。

examples.en: Dad bought a new tire for the family car.
examples.zh: 爸爸為家裡的車買了一個新輪胎。

examples.en: Check the air in each tire before a long trip.
examples.zh: 長途旅行前，要檢查每個輪胎的氣壓。

examples.en: Could you pass me a tissue, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你遞給我一張面紙嗎？

examples.en: Muscle tissue needs protein to grow strong.
examples.zh: 肌肉組織需要蛋白質才能長得強壯。

examples.en: She wrapped the glass cup in soft tissue paper.
examples.zh: 她用柔軟的包裝薄紙把玻璃杯包起來。

examples.en: I did not like the angry tone of his voice.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡他生氣的語氣。

examples.en: The phone made a loud tone when the call ended.
examples.zh: 通話結束時，電話發出了很大的聲音。

examples.en: The painter used warm tones for the sunset.
examples.zh: 畫家用暖色調來畫夕陽。

examples.en: A typical school day begins at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 一般的上學日是從八點開始。

examples.en: It was typical of him to arrive late again.
examples.zh: 他又遲到了，真是一貫的作風。

examples.en: Rice and soup make a typical Taiwanese dinner.
examples.zh: 米飯和湯是典型的台灣晚餐。

examples.en: We will go hiking unless it rains tomorrow.
examples.zh: 除非明天下雨，否則我們會去健行。

examples.en: You cannot enter the room unless you have a ticket.
examples.zh: 沒有票就不能進入這個房間。

examples.en: Don't call me unless it is really important.
examples.zh: 除非真的很重要，否則不要打電話給我。

senses.zh: 心煩的；難過的；不舒服的

examples.en: She was upset because she lost her notebook.
examples.zh: 她因為弄丟了筆記本而心煩。

examples.en: Dad has an upset stomach after the spicy dinner.
examples.zh: 吃了辛辣的晚餐後，爸爸的胃不舒服。

examples.en: Don't be upset about one bad test score.
examples.zh: 不要為了一次考不好而難過。

examples.en: The bad news upset everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 這個壞消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都很難過。

examples.en: I'm sorry if my words upset you.
examples.zh: 如果我的話讓你難過，我很抱歉。

examples.en: The heavy rain upset our travel plans.
examples.zh: 大雨打亂了我們的旅行計畫。

examples.en: The family gained great wealth from their business.
examples.zh: 這個家庭從事業中累積了龐大的財富。

examples.en: Health is worth more than wealth.
examples.zh: 健康比財富更有價值。

examples.en: The library has a wealth of information about local history.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館有大量關於本地歷史的資料。

examples.en: This suitcase weighs more than twenty kilograms.
examples.zh: 這個行李箱重達二十公斤以上。

examples.en: The clerk will weigh the fruit before you pay.
examples.zh: 店員會在你付錢前先秤水果的重量。

examples.en: You should weigh the pros and cons before you decide.
examples.zh: 做決定之前，你應該先權衡利弊。

examples.en: Whenever I feel sleepy, I drink a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 每當我想睡覺時，我就喝一杯茶。

examples.en: You can visit us whenever you are free.
examples.zh: 你有空的時候隨時都可以來找我們。

examples.en: My dog barks whenever someone knocks on the door.
examples.zh: 每當有人敲門，我的狗就會叫。

senses.zh: 無論在哪裡；不管到哪裡

examples.en: You can sit wherever you like in the classroom.
examples.zh: 你可以坐在教室裡任何你喜歡的位子。

examples.en: Wherever she goes, she takes her camera with her.
examples.zh: 不管她去哪裡，都會帶著相機。

examples.en: Put the box wherever there is enough space.
examples.zh: 只要有足夠的空間，就把箱子放在那裡。

examples.en: Please whisper in the library so others can study.
examples.zh: 在圖書館請小聲說話，才不會影響別人讀書。

examples.en: She leaned over and whispered the answer to me.
examples.zh: 她靠過來，小聲地把答案告訴我。

examples.en: The children whispered quietly during the movie.
examples.zh: 孩子們在電影放映時輕聲說話。

examples.en: She spoke in a whisper so the baby would not wake up.
examples.zh: 她輕聲說話，以免吵醒寶寶。

examples.en: I heard a soft whisper behind me.
examples.zh: 我聽到身後傳來輕輕的低語聲。

examples.en: The teacher's whisper was still clear in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 在安靜的房間裡，老師的低語依然聽得很清楚。

examples.en: Whoever finishes first can leave early.
examples.zh: 不管誰先完成，都可以提早離開。

examples.en: Give this message to whoever answers the phone.
examples.zh: 請把這個訊息轉告給接電話的人。

examples.en: You can invite whoever you want to the party.
examples.zh: 你可以邀請任何你想邀請的人來參加派對。

examples.en: Don't touch the loose wire behind the television.
examples.zh: 不要碰電視後面鬆脫的電線。

examples.en: The farmer put a wire fence around the field.
examples.zh: 農夫在田地周圍圍上了鐵絲網。

examples.en: She used a thin wire to hang the picture.
examples.zh: 她用一條細鐵絲把畫掛起來。

examples.en: The workers will wire the new classroom next week.
examples.zh: 工人下週會為新教室配電線。

examples.en: He wired the two boards together with a thin line.
examples.zh: 他用細金屬線把兩塊板子綁在一起。

examples.en: They wired the house before they painted the walls.
examples.zh: 他們在粉刷牆壁之前先把屋內的電線接好。

examples.en: We ate roasted yam on a cold winter night.
examples.zh: 我們在寒冷的冬夜吃烤地瓜。

examples.en: My grandmother cooks yam soup for the whole family.
examples.zh: 奶奶為全家人煮了山藥湯。

examples.en: A yam is rich in fiber and vitamins.
examples.zh: 地瓜含有豐富的纖維和維生素。

examples.en: The class teaches the basics of computer use.
examples.zh: 這堂課教授電腦使用的基礎。

examples.en: You should learn the basics before trying hard problems.
examples.zh: 在嘗試困難的題目之前，你應該先學好基礎。

examples.en: Her father taught her the basics of swimming.
examples.zh: 她的爸爸教她游泳的基本要領。

examples.en: The school gymnasium is big enough for five hundred students.
examples.zh: 學校的體育館大到可以容納五百名學生。

examples.en: We play basketball in the gymnasium on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天我們在體育館打籃球。

examples.en: The new gymnasium opens to the public next month.
examples.zh: 新的體育館下個月開放給民眾使用。

examples.en: Please enter your password to log in.
examples.zh: 請輸入你的密碼登入。

examples.en: I forgot my password, so I had to reset it.
examples.zh: 我忘記密碼了，所以只好重設。

examples.en: Choose a password that is hard to guess.
examples.zh: 請選一個不容易被猜到的密碼。

senses.zh: 多岩石的；崎嶇的；不穩定的

examples.en: The path up the mountain was steep and rocky.
examples.zh: 上山的小徑又陡又多石。

examples.en: We walked along a rocky beach at sunset.
examples.zh: 我們在日落時沿著多岩石的海灘散步。

examples.en: The company had a rocky start in its first year.
examples.zh: 這家公司創業第一年的起步並不順利。

examples.en: Many countries work together to fight terrorism.
examples.zh: 許多國家合作對抗恐怖主義。

examples.en: Our teacher explained how terrorism affects world travel.
examples.zh: 老師說明了恐怖主義如何影響世界各地的旅遊。

examples.en: The news report was about a new law against terrorism.
examples.zh: 這則新聞報導的是一項新的反恐法律。

examples.en: The airport has strict rules to stop any terrorist.
examples.zh: 機場有嚴格的規定來防範恐怖分子。

examples.en: The movie is about a police team that searches for a terrorist.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一個警察小組追捕恐怖分子的故事。

examples.en: The government said every terrorist would be brought to court.
examples.zh: 政府表示每一名恐怖分子都會被送上法庭。

examples.en: Please read the dialogue between Tom and Anna.
examples.zh: 請朗讀湯姆和安娜之間的對話。

examples.en: The dialogue in this movie sounds natural.
examples.zh: 這部電影的對白聽起來很自然。

examples.en: The two leaders hope to continue their dialogue next year.
examples.zh: 兩位領導人希望明年繼續進行對話。

examples.en: My little sister made a drawing of our family.
examples.zh: 我的妹妹畫了一幅我們一家人的圖。

examples.en: The art teacher hung every drawing on the wall.
examples.zh: 美術老師把每一張圖畫都掛在牆上。

examples.en: Drawing is her favorite activity after school.
examples.zh: 畫畫是她放學後最喜歡的活動。

examples.en: The fireman climbed the ladder to help the cat.
examples.zh: 消防員爬上梯子去救那隻貓。

examples.en: A fireman visited our school to talk about safety.
examples.zh: 一位消防員來到我們學校談安全。

examples.en: My brother wants to be a fireman when he grows up.
examples.zh: 我弟弟長大後想當消防員。

examples.en: The saleswoman showed us several kinds of shoes.
examples.zh: 那位女售貨員拿了好幾種鞋子給我們看。

examples.en: My aunt works as a saleswoman in a department store.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在百貨公司擔任女售貨員。

examples.en: The saleswoman gave me a discount on the jacket.
examples.zh: 女售貨員給了我那件外套折扣。

examples.en: I thought it was easy, but it was actually quite hard.
examples.zh: 我原本以為很簡單，其實相當困難。

examples.en: Do you actually live near the train station?
examples.zh: 你真的住在火車站附近嗎？

examples.en: She is actually older than she looks.
examples.zh: 她其實比外表看起來還要年長。

examples.en: I saw an advertisement for a new bookstore on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上看到一則新書店的廣告。

examples.en: The company put an advertisement in the newspaper to find workers.
examples.zh: 那家公司在報紙上刊登廣告來徵人。

examples.en: This advertisement makes the snack look delicious.
examples.zh: 這支廣告讓點心看起來很好吃。

examples.en: My cousin moved to America to study art.
examples.zh: 我表哥搬到美國去學藝術。

examples.en: Many people in America enjoy watching baseball.
examples.zh: 美國有許多人喜歡看棒球。

examples.en: Christopher Columbus sailed across the ocean and reached America.
examples.zh: 哥倫布橫渡海洋，抵達了美洲。

examples.en: She likes to listen to American pop songs.
examples.zh: 她喜歡聽美國流行歌曲。

examples.en: The American team arrived at the airport this morning.
examples.zh: 美國隊今天早上抵達機場。

examples.en: We visited an American school during our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了一所美國的學校。

examples.en: My new neighbor is an American.
examples.zh: 我的新鄰居是美國人。

examples.en: Many Americans eat a big breakfast on weekends.
examples.zh: 許多美國人週末會吃豐盛的早餐。

examples.en: The Americans in our class speak a little Chinese.
examples.zh: 我們班上的美國人會說一點中文。

examples.en: Does anyone know where the teacher is?
examples.zh: 有人知道老師在哪裡嗎？

examples.en: Anyone can join the reading club after school.
examples.zh: 任何人都可以參加放學後的讀書會。

examples.en: I didn't tell anyone about the surprise party.
examples.zh: 我沒有把驚喜派對的事告訴任何人。

examples.en: My birthday is in April.
examples.zh: 我的生日在四月。

examples.en: The spring vacation starts in early April.
examples.zh: 春假從四月初開始。

examples.en: It often rains in Taipei in April.
examples.zh: 台北四月常常下雨。

examples.en: We are classmates in the same school club.
examples.zh: 我們是同一個社團的同學。

examples.en: Where are my keys? I can't find them.
examples.zh: 我的鑰匙在哪裡？我找不到。

examples.en: There are twenty students in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有二十位學生。

examples.en: Grandfather likes to read the newspaper in his armchair.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡坐在他的扶手椅上看報紙。

examples.en: We bought a soft armchair for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們為客廳買了一張柔軟的扶手椅。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping on the old armchair.
examples.zh: 貓正睡在那張舊扶手椅上。

examples.en: We usually go to the beach in August.
examples.zh: 我們八月通常會去海邊。

examples.en: The new school year begins at the end of August.
examples.zh: 新學年在八月底開始。

examples.en: It is very hot in Taiwan in August.
examples.zh: 台灣八月非常炎熱。

examples.en: The leaves turn red and yellow in autumn.
examples.zh: 樹葉在秋天會轉紅變黃。

examples.en: Autumn is a good season for hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 秋天是上山健行的好季節。

examples.en: We eat moon cakes in the middle of autumn.
examples.zh: 我們在中秋節吃月餅。

examples.en: The beginning of the movie was a little slow.
examples.zh: 這部電影的開頭有點慢。

examples.en: At the beginning of the year, we make new plans.
examples.zh: 年初的時候，我們會訂下新計畫。

examples.en: This small shop was the beginning of a big business.
examples.zh: 這間小店是一個大事業的起點。

examples.en: Today is my best friend's birthday.
examples.zh: 今天是我最要好的朋友的生日。

examples.en: We sang a song for Mom on her birthday.
examples.zh: 我們在媽媽生日那天為她唱了一首歌。

examples.en: What would you like for your birthday this year?
examples.zh: 你今年生日想要什麼禮物？

examples.en: The kids ran to the store to buy some candy.
examples.zh: 孩子們跑去商店買糖果。

examples.en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果對牙齒不好。

examples.en: The teacher gave each student a piece of candy.
examples.zh: 老師給每位學生一顆糖果。

senses.zh: 粗心的；不小心的；漫不經心的

examples.en: I made a careless mistake on the math test.
examples.zh: 我在數學考試中犯了一個粗心的錯誤。

examples.en: He was careless with his new phone and dropped it.
examples.zh: 他對新手機不夠小心，結果把它摔到地上。

examples.en: A careless driver can cause a serious accident.
examples.zh: 粗心的駕駛可能造成嚴重的意外。

examples.en: She looked at the snow with childlike joy.
examples.zh: 她帶著孩子般的喜悅看著雪。

examples.en: Grandpa still has a childlike smile on his face.
examples.zh: 爺爺臉上依然帶著天真的笑容。

examples.en: The artist's childlike pictures make many people happy.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家天真童趣的畫作讓許多人感到開心。

examples.en: Chinese New Year is a big holiday in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 農曆新年是台灣的重大節日。

examples.en: She is reading a Chinese book about history.
examples.zh: 她正在讀一本有關歷史的中文書。

examples.en: We had a Chinese dinner at my uncle's house.
examples.zh: 我們在叔叔家吃了一頓中式晚餐。

examples.en: Chinese is my first language.
examples.zh: 中文是我的母語。

examples.en: Many tourists are learning Chinese before their trip.
examples.zh: 許多遊客在旅行前會學習中文。

examples.en: The Chinese in this town celebrate the festival together.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮上的華人一起慶祝這個節日。

examples.en: We decorate a tree at home every Christmas.
examples.zh: 我們每年聖誕節都會在家裡裝飾一棵樹。

examples.en: She gave her brother a book for Christmas.
examples.zh: 她送了弟弟一本書當作聖誕禮物。

examples.en: The shopping mall is full of people before Christmas.
examples.zh: 聖誕節前，購物中心擠滿了人。

examples.en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我們的教室在二樓。

examples.en: The students cleaned the classroom after school.
examples.zh: 學生們放學後打掃教室。

examples.en: There is a big clock on the wall of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室的牆上有一個大時鐘。

examples.en: When I was five, I could already ride a bike.
examples.zh: 我五歲的時候就已經會騎腳踏車了。

examples.en: Could you please open the window a little?
examples.zh: 可以請你把窗戶打開一點嗎？

examples.en: It could rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

examples.en: The MRT was too crowded during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時間的捷運太擁擠了。

examples.en: We could not find a seat in the crowded restaurant.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的餐廳裡，我們找不到座位。

examples.en: Night markets are always crowded on weekends.
examples.zh: 夜市在週末總是人潮擁擠。

examples.en: Winter vacation starts in December.
examples.zh: 寒假從十二月開始。

examples.en: The weather is cold in December.
examples.zh: 十二月的天氣很冷。

examples.en: Our school holds a music show every December.
examples.zh: 我們學校每年十二月都會舉辦音樂表演。

examples.en: Children hunt for colored eggs at Easter.
examples.zh: 孩子們在復活節尋找彩蛋。

examples.en: Easter is a spring holiday in many countries.
examples.zh: 復活節在許多國家是春季的節日。

examples.en: Our family will visit my aunt in America for Easter.
examples.zh: 我們全家復活節要去美國拜訪阿姨。

examples.en: Four plus four makes eight.
examples.zh: 四加四等於八。

examples.en: The bus leaves at eight.
examples.zh: 公車八點出發。

examples.en: There are eight people in my family.
examples.zh: 我的家裡有八個人。

examples.en: I have eight pencils in my bag.
examples.zh: 我的書包裡有八枝鉛筆。

examples.en: My cousin is eight years old.
examples.zh: 我的表弟八歲。

examples.en: The movie lasted for eight hours.
examples.zh: 這場電影演了八個小時。
